jobs.description_text:
About the Role

As an Engineering Manager on Chime's Data Intelligence Platform, leading the Data Integration Platform team, you will own the group that builds and operates the platform and infrastructure for the ingress and egress of first-party and third-party data into and out of Chime's ecosystem. Your team will be responsible for building and operating reliable, scalable, and secure integration pipelines and connectors that move data between Chime's internal systems and external partners, vendors, and data providers, powering analytics, experimentation, and AI-driven product experiences across Chime.

You'll partner closely with other Data Intelligence Platform squads as well as Product Engineering, Security, and Analytics teams to define integration patterns, data contracts, and SLAs that govern how data enters and leaves Chime, supporting both high-scale batch workloads and latency-sensitive real-time flows. Your leadership will directly impact how Chime ingests, exchanges, and delivers data - enabling trusted, self-serve, AI-ready data for Chimers across the company.

Chime’s data integration platform is entering its next phase. As our data ecosystem grows, we have a significant opportunity to simplify and standardize how data moves across streaming, batch, and third-party integrations. You will lead the evolution toward a unified, secure, and reliable data conveyance platform while helping advance Chime’s lakehouse architecture

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer, Human Agent Tooling
jobs.description_text:
About the role

The Human Agent Tooling team builds the software Chime's support agents use every day to help members. When a member has a problem a bot can't solve, a human agent picks it up — and the tools we build are what let that agent understand the member's situation, take the right action, and resolve the issue quickly and safely. That includes the agent workspace, case management, the systems that surface member context in real time, and the controls that govern what actions agents can take.

Our mission is to make every human support interaction faster, safer, and more effective. When our tools work well, agents resolve issues in fewer clicks and members get better answers — and we measure our success by both.

We're investing heavily in this platform: modernizing the agent experience, building safer and more granular access controls, and improving how agent tooling connects to the rest of Chime's systems. We work closely with Product, Operations, and the agents themselves to shape what great support tooling looks like.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $117,000.00 and up to $162,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

About the role

We are hiring a Sr. Data Scientist, Marketing (Referrals) to help us understand how our referral investment drives member acquisition and long-term value. Unlike traditional paid channels, referrals operate through member-to-member advocacy, dual-sided incentives, and viral loops, requiring a distinct measurement lens that accounts for organic bleed, incentive sensitivity, and long-term referred member behavior.

Each product marketer is the CMO of their product domain and focused on four pillars:

  1. Defining and executing product positioning, messaging, and launches 
  2. Enabling and supporting the go-to-market and marketing teams
  3. Informing product strategy
  4. Driving product adoption and success.
